item.title: Annual Prize Giving Day Celebrates Top Achievers
item.excerpt: Students, parents and staff gathered to celebrate outstanding performance across academics and co-curricular activities.
item.body:
Students, parents and staff gathered to celebrate outstanding performance across academics and co-curricular activities.

The school community continues to demonstrate its commitment to excellence. We thank our learners, staff and parents for their continued support.

More details will be shared through official school communication channels.
